shells.base: Native ComfyUI/LiteGraph node shell; DOM face gets the same 6px inset.
shells.bare: Chromeless/baseless node; DOM face gets the same 6px inset from its own visual edge.

controls.slider: Filled track + draggable thumb + synchronized numeric input
controls.color_picker: Theme-aware trigger swatch + hex popup with native picker + swatches
controls.segmented_group: Pill button tabs/group with active indicator (e.g. snap, modes)
controls.menu: Theme-aware context/dropdown menu with optional search
controls.preview_card: Standard contained image/HUD preview box with title/dimension badges

context_menu.submenu_indicator: Muted chevron; no cyan side bar

recreate_compatibility: Resolve string node ids passed to LiteGraph.connect by older/current Manager combinations.
